errors.text_span: The plot contains three distinct lines without markers. A blue dashed line, corresponding to the legend entry "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71", begins at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, exhibits minor fluctuations below 0.5 up to layer 17, and then sharply increases to a peak of approximately 4.3 at layer 23. An orange dotted line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05", starts near 0 and maintains a steady, flat trajectory very close to the x-axis, concluding at roughly 0.1 at layer 23. A green solid line, labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04", starts near 0 and similarly maintains a flat trajectory close to zero throughout the x-axis range, also ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
